<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#E7ECF0"/>
  
  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="35" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="22" y="22" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#141619">9:41</text>
  <rect x="326" y="14" width="3" height="7" rx="1" fill="#141619"/>
  <rect x="331" y="11" width="3" height="10" rx="1" fill="#141619"/>
  <rect x="336" y="8" width="3" height="13" rx="1" fill="#141619"/>
  <rect x="341" y="5" width="3" height="16" rx="1" fill="#141619"/>
  <circle cx="359" cy="14" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#141619" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="362" y1="17" x2="365" y2="20" stroke="#141619" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="371" y="8" width="17" height="13" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#141619" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="389" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#141619"/>
  <rect x="373" y="10" width="12" height="9" rx="2" fill="#141619"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="35" width="390" height="54" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <polyline points="27,61 20,67 27,73" fill="none" stroke="#141619" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="45" y="70" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#141619">Messages</text>
  <text x="350" y="69" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#4C9EEB">Done</text>
  <line x1="0" y1="89" x2="390" y2="89" stroke="#CED5DC" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Intro -->
  <rect x="0" y="90" width="390" height="83" fill="#E7ECF0"/>
  <text x="20" y="117" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="16" font-weight="600" fill="#141619">Direct Messages</text>
  <text x="20" y="141" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#687684">Manage who can message you and how your</text>
  <text x="20" y="160" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="400" fill="#687684">messages and receipts appear.</text>

  <!-- Privacy card shadow and card -->
  <rect x="12" y="184" width="366" height="191" rx="5" fill="#CED5DC" opacity="0.7"/>
  <rect x="12" y="183" width="366" height="191" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="25" y="209" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#687684">PRIVACY</text>
  <line x1="12" y1="221" x2="378" y2="221" stroke="#CED5DC"/>
  
  <text x="25" y="247" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#141619">Allow message requests</text>
  <text x="25" y="266" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#687684">Receive messages from people you don't follow</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="315" y="237" width="51" height="31" rx="16" fill="#67CE00"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="252.5" r="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="25" y1="282" x2="365" y2="282" stroke="#CED5DC"/>
  
  <text x="25" y="307" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#141619">Allow messages from everyone</text>
  <text x="25" y="326" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#687684">People can send you a message request</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="315" y="296" width="51" height="31" rx="16" fill="#ABABAB"/>
    <circle cx="331" cy="311.5" r="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="25" y1="343" x2="365" y2="343" stroke="#CED5DC"/>
  <text x="25" y="365" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#4C9EEB">Learn more about message privacy</text>

  <!-- Filtering card -->
  <rect x="12" y="390" width="366" height="188" rx="5" fill="#CED5DC" opacity="0.7"/>
  <rect x="12" y="389" width="366" height="188" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="25" y="415" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#687684">FILTERING</text>
  <line x1="12" y1="427" x2="378" y2="427" stroke="#CED5DC"/>
  
  <text x="25" y="453" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#141619">Filter low-quality messages</text>
  <text x="25" y="472" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#687684">Hide potentially spammy requests</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="315" y="443" width="51" height="31" rx="16" fill="#67CE00"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="458.5" r="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <line x1="25" y1="488" x2="365" y2="488" stroke="#CED5DC"/>
  
  <text x="25" y="513" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#141619">Show read receipts</text>
  <text x="25" y="532" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#687684">Let people know when you've read their message</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="315" y="503" width="51" height="31" rx="16" fill="#ABABAB"/>
    <circle cx="331" cy="518.5" r="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <text x="25" y="562" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#4C9EEB">Learn more about message filtering</text>

  <!-- Receipts card -->
  <rect x="12" y="594" width="366" height="132" rx="5" fill="#CED5DC" opacity="0.7"/>
  <rect x="12" y="593" width="366" height="132" rx="5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="25" y="619" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#687684">RECEIPTS</text>
  <line x1="12" y1="631" x2="378" y2="631" stroke="#CED5DC"/>
  
  <text x="25" y="657" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#141619">Show typing indicators</text>
  <text x="25" y="676" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#687684">Show when you're typing a reply</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="315" y="647" width="51" height="31" rx="16" fill="#67CE00"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="662.5" r="12" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <text x="25" y="710" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#4C9EEB">Learn more about receipts</text>

  <!-- Footer note -->
  <text x="20" y="754" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#687684">Your settings apply to all conversations on this account.</text>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="780" width="390" height="64" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="780" x2="390" y2="780" stroke="#CED5DC"/>
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,797 29,805 29,817 49,817 49,805" fill="none" stroke="#687684" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polyline points="28,805 39,796 50,805" fill="none" stroke="#687684" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="39" y="835" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#687684">Home</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="117" cy="806" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#687684" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="123" y1="812" x2="130" y2="819" stroke="#687684" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="117" y="835" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#687684">Explore</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="182" y="798" width="18" height="14" rx="4" fill="none" stroke="#4C9EEB" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <polygon points="186,812 184,817 191,812" fill="#4C9EEB"/>
    <circle cx="188" cy="805" r="1.2" fill="#4C9EEB"/>
    <circle cx="194" cy="805" r="1.2" fill="#4C9EEB"/>
    <text x="191" y="835" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="600" fill="#4C9EEB">Messages</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="273" cy="802" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#687684" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="273" cy="815" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#687684" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="273" y="835" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#687684">Profile</text>
  </g>
  <g>
    <circle cx="350" cy="806" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#687684" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="350" cy="806" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#687684" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <line x1="350" y1="794" x2="350" y2="798" stroke="#687684" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="350" y1="814" x2="350" y2="818" stroke="#687684" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="350" y="835" text-anchor="middle" font-family="SF Pro Text, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#687684">Settings</text>
  </g>
  <rect x="145" y="838" width="100" height="4" rx="2" fill="#060606"/>
</svg>
